purpose: Three feasibility gates: full AMGC training, independent mask/seed repeats, and label-free confidence weighting ablation
hardware: CPU only; no local GPU driver changes

amgc.note: Fixed-mask convergence check; one seed cannot establish repeatability

sdcn_repeats.report: fixed final epoch, paired masks and model seeds

confidence.calibration: Within each mask, hide 20% of originally observed nodes to fit a ridge model predicting log FP reconstruction error from four label-free signals
confidence.honest_test: A disjoint 20% of originally observed nodes is artificially hidden and scored without fitting on it
confidence.original_missing_audit: True attributes of originally missing benchmark nodes are accessed only after confidence scores are frozen, for offline correlation analysis
confidence.weight_mapping: Observed=1; missing score rank linearly mapped to (0.2,1.0), mean approximately 0.6

weighted_ablation.loss: Confidence applied to both nodewise KL terms and normalized by sum of node weights; reconstruction unchanged
weighted_ablation.selection: No label-based epoch or parameter selection
